purpose: Validate real-source accounting end to end before any H17-H19 return observation
selection_basis: Corporate-event dates and previously reconciled sources, not measured returns
checks: bonus credited only on delivery date
stopping_rule: One fixed matrix, fix accounting errors and repeat only failed controls; no optimization or scientific verdict
limitations: The two action controls use fractional mathematical quantities
ABEV uses 100-share order rounding and ordinary-market quotes
No taxes, broker-specific fills or bonus fractional auction modeled
BBAS case measures the split mechanism with cash excluded
These cases cannot establish portfolio alpha, strategy profitability or complete universe coverage
